name: clean_match_with_address_diff
description: TIN + name match an existing supplier exactly; street address differs -> clean update with a field diff.

name: no_match_new_supplier
description: TIN and name appear nowhere in the supplier master -> new supplier.

name: tin_hijack_name_mismatch
description: Extracted TIN matches Acme's on-file TIN, but the legal name is completely different -> possible TIN hijack, escalate.

name: unsigned_form_blocks_auto_decision
description: Clean, unmatched supplier, but the form is unsigned -> CRITICAL validation flag forces human review even though the matcher alone would say CREATE_NEW.

name: wrong_form_w8_sent_by_mistake
description: A W-8, not a W-9 -- no field anchors match at all despite a real embedded text layer.

name: invalid_file_rejected
description: Not a PDF/PNG/JPEG at all -> rejected before any extraction runs.

name: scanned_photo_routes_to_vlm_mock
description: JPEG photo -> classifier routes to VLM path; with no API key configured, MockVLMExtractor honestly reports every field unknown, which correctly forces human review rather than guessing.

name: scanned_pdf_wrapper_routes_to_vlm
description: PDF with a full-page image and zero embedded text -> classifier's stage-2 probe catches the scanned wrapper and routes to VLM, same as a direct photo.

name: banking_change_overrides_clean_match
description: TIN + name match Acme cleanly, but the secondary payload's bank routing/account differs from what's on file -> forced to human review regardless of the otherwise-clean match.

name: tenant_isolation_same_name_different_tenant
description: The exact same document (Acme Corporation, TIN 27-4821093) submitted under a DIFFERENT tenant that happens to also have an unrelated supplier also named 'Acme Corporation' (different TIN/address/tax classification). Proves tenant_id is enforced at the query layer: tenant_pairsoft_042's real Acme record (sup_00417) must never be visible to, or matched against, tenant_globex_099's request -- even with a perfect 1.0 name-similarity score against tenant_globex_099's own same-named supplier.
